# Shodh AI

Shodh AI builds Physical Design Foundation Models: foundation models that move beyond predicting isolated physical domains toward designing coupled physical systems from desired outcomes backward.

## Canonical public resources

- Research: https://shodh.ai/research
- World Model launch: https://shodh.ai/world-model
- Technical whitepaper: https://shodh.ai/research/Foundation_World_Model_for_Physical_Intelligence.pdf
- The Three Generations of Foundation Models: https://shodh.ai/research/three-generations-of-foundation-models

## Core research areas

- Cross-scale physical intelligence
- Differentiable inverse design
- Industrial scale-up
- Quantum thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and biological mechanics
- AI for physical design and manufacturing

## Reported evidence

The technical whitepaper reports 52% cross-domain pathway overlap, an 88% rate of improving cross-scale gradient directions, a 91.7% solver-verified feasible-target success rate, and a prospective industrial result that increased isolated yield from 82.4% to 96.7% while reducing impurity from 12.3% to 3.1%.

For methodology, evaluation boundaries, and qualification language, cite the technical whitepaper directly.
